note: Stage-5D.1 semantic corridor discriminability audit. ANALYSIS ONLY: built against the shipped production headers, modifies nothing. The ORACLE arms (B, D) and the penalty analysis are the ONLY readers of the ground-truth class and are ANALYTICAL / EVALUATION ONLY -- no ground-truth label enters any runtime path. The expanded window is applied ONLY inside this file's rasterization model; no production parameter is changed.

windows.expanded_source: the layer's own declareParameter default, predicted_obstacle_layer.cpp:44, which equals the half-extent of the 6x6 m local costmap

policy_role.what_it_clamps: the ITERATION WINDOW half-extents half_x/half_y, post-Stage-5C.1; membership is tested against the semi-axes AS PUBLISHED, so it is a bound on WORK and on PLANNER-VISIBLE EXTENT, never a truncation of the published region

expressible_profiles.interpretation: A(PEDESTRIAN)={ped,bike,vehicle} and A(VEHICLE)={vehicle,unknown} both envelope to the fallback (40.0 m/s, 10.0 m/s^2), so under the SHIPPED ambiguity policy the runtime system can express only TWO corridors -- BIKE and fallback -- and VEHICLE vs UNKNOWN is identical BY CONSTRUCTION at every radius. This bound is independent of max_influence_radius.

part2_profile_separation.method: Every class profile is evaluated on the SAME recorded track state, the same Kalman covariance and the same horizon, so the only difference between classes is the capability profile. Cells replicate post-Stage-5C.1 rasterizeReachableSet.

part3_classifier_penalty.definition: Per recorded sample: EXACT = the runtime-selected profile equals the oracle-ideal (true class, singleton ambiguity set) profile; OVER-CONSERVATIVE = it strictly dominates it; UNDER-CONSERVATIVE = it does not dominate it. UNDER-CONSERVATIVE must be 0.

arms.A: runtime labels + 0.55 m window (= Stage-5D production-candidate behaviour)
arms.B2/D2: ground-truth label pushed through the UNMODIFIED shipped selector (closure envelope, = Stage-5D arm C), at 0.55 m and 3.00 m -- reported so the ambiguity POLICY and the label ERROR are separable without weakening the policy
